quotationVerification.constructionRuleAudited: The authoredCatalog mutation fields state the quote is 'taken from the start through the first terminal period, excluding that period.' This was tested rather than trusted. EV-3's exactByteIntent contains three non-terminal periods ('docs/coop/v1-slice.md', "executes.'", 'section 7.1'); a naive first-period cut would truncate mid-path. Applying the rule at the sentence boundary reproduces all ten fixture bytes exactly. The stated rule is accurate as written.
